craft_notes: Sthāyin: three takings. Rows: pupil, God, master. Read aloud: triple take.

lines: There is the staying, the pupil's cultured fitness-placing —
as the whetting of teeth; the God's toward-work-upturned-ness-grasping,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra adhivāsanaṃ śiṣyasya saṃskṛtayogyatādhānam amblīkaraṇam iva dantānāṃ devasya kartavyonmukhatvagrāhaṇam guros tadgrahaṇam
